explore-historic-porto-a-self-guided-wal.notes: Ticket prices are what will drift: Clérigos (€10), Palácio da Bolsa (€14), plus Lello and São Francisco prices which the guide deliberately does not state. Bolsa closes on event dates.

family-fun-porto-kid-friendly-activities.notes: Prices most likely to move: Zoo Santo Inácio, FC Porto tour, Serralves, SEA LIFE, Tram Museum (usually each January). Zoo, Palácio de Cristal and World of Discoveries have seasonal hours; WOW renames/rotates its museums.

made-in-porto-shop-online.notes: Hand-checked by the owner: prices and shipping terms on each brand's own site. Prices, couriers and which brands ship abroad change most.

porto-a-seasonal-guide-for-your-2025-202.notes: Year-specific dates to refresh: Queima 2027 (1-8 May), Primavera Sound 2027 (10-13 Jun), MEO Marés 2027 (16-18 Jul), Fantasporto 2027 (26 Feb-7 Mar), WOW é Natal 2026 (opens 21 Nov). Once those pass, replace with the next edition or the usual timing. Also check Serralves em Festa, Elétrico, Essência do Vinho 2027 dates when announced; Casa da Música tour (€12) and Ideal Clube (€21/€16) prices.

porto-day-trips-your-ultimate-douro-vall.notes: Quinta tasting prices (Seixo €26, Pacheca from €26, Tedo €36/€64) and CP fares (Pinhão €12.45) change most often; the Douro timetable changed in Aug 2026. Guimarães prices and the Bom Jesus funicular fare (stop times shifted due to works) are also worth a monthly look.

porto-neighborhood-guide-where-to-stay-e.notes: Prices most likely to move: Palácio da Bolsa (€14), Clérigos (€10), Serralves (€24), Soares dos Reis (€10), six-bridges cruise (from €18). Casa Carolina listed as temporarily closed until 30 Nov 2026; recheck it reopened. Michelin star counts change each spring (Vila Foz 1, Pedro Lemos 1, Euskalduna 1, Yeatman 2).

porto-nightlife-2025-2026-fado-bars-unfo.notes: Most volatile: rooftop bars (Rooftop Santa Catarina status unclear, PortoBello already closed), Tendinha dos Clérigos opening nights, fado ticket prices (Ideal Clube €21/€16), Casa da Música tour price (€12), bar hours (Torto, Royal Cocktail Club, Douro Sky Lounge seasonal 13-19).

porto-on-a-budget-free-sights-cheap-eats.notes: Andante fares change every 1 January (check andante.pt). Porto Card was off sale since July 2026 for restructuring; recheck visitporto.travel. Clérigos night ticket and Lello voucher price also move.

porto-shopping-guide-your-map-to-vintage.notes: Most likely to go stale: Porto Belo and Mercado da Alegria days/hours (Agenda Porto), Chiclete Shop's address, Humana's Porto shops (Passos Manuel reopened 2 Nov 2026), doBARRO workshop prices, Urban Market venue. Owner-checked text kept; only dashes, a few AI-tell words and the generic wrap-up paragraph were changed.

portos-best-beaches-your-2025-2026-surf-.notes: Blue Flag list changes every May/June (bandeiraazul.abaae.pt); the APA bathing-season link has 2026 in its URL and needs updating each year. Piscina das Marés dates/prices and surf school existence are next most likely to change.

portos-best-coffee-pastis-de-nata-the-20.notes: Specialty cafés move and close often (Fábrica closed, C'alma moved). Hours here come mostly from Google Maps listings, so re-check C'alma, Época, Combi and Casa Berlim first.

portos-best-views-rooftops-viewpoints-fo.notes: Title keeps a plain '2026' (suggest dropping it in 2027). Rooftop bars are seasonal and change hands; LIFT Rooftop was dropped as 'Closed for now'; re-add only if it reopens. Clérigos and Serra do Pilar prices will drift.

secret-porto-a-guide-to-the-citys-hidden.notes: Most likely to go stale: Porto Bridge Climb price (€20, set 31/03/2024), Tram Museum and Serralves ticket prices, Taberna dos Mercadores hours/booking window, Gazela hours. Capela Incomum hours were deliberately left out (third-party listings disagree).

sip-savor-porto-your-2025-guide-to-port-.notes: Lodge hours switch between winter (Nov-Mar) and summer (Apr-Oct) schedules at Graham's and Cockburn's; Sandeman's listed prices (€23/€32/€53) are the most likely to change. Wine bar hours come from Visit Porto / the bars' own sites.

the-ultimate-art-lovers-guide-to-porto-2.notes: Festival dates are pinned to the next edition (Fantasporto 26 Feb-7 Mar 2027, Essência do Vinho 18-21 Feb 2027, Primavera Sound 10-13 Jun 2027) and must be rolled forward after each. Also re-check Serralves and Soares dos Reis prices, and that the murals (especially Half Rabbit and Liqen's cat) are still there.

the-ultimate-food-guide-to-porto-5-dishe.notes: Most hours come from Google Maps listings (Café Santiago, Gazela, Bolhão and Bom Sucesso from their own sites). Small tascas (Escondidinho do Barredo, O Buraco, O Ernesto) are the most likely to change hours or close; Michelin stars change each spring.
